messages:
Ivy (Customer Success): FYI invoice 5501 (Sentinel AI) failed during today's card sweep. Stripe returned decline `do_not_honor`. Customer is on an onboarding call and wants to pay today via wire or ACH. Can we retry or provide wire instructions?

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=5501 customer=SentinelAI provider=Stripe code=do_not_honor id=pi_8Yx... log=\"card_decline_do_not_honor\"

Ralph (Finance): We can do one manual retry now if you want, but gateway rules suggest waiting ~10m after the initial decline. Recommend offering Plaid ACH first; if their bank blocks micro-deposits (common on some business savings), accept a bank outbound confirmation or letter. Please share billing contact.

Tess (Ops): Ops note: never do back-to-back auths within 5m. If you want a manual retry, schedule +15m to be safe. If they wire and post proof, I can unblock provisioning immediately.

Noah (Sales): Hold activation until payment or proof of wire. If they wire now, we can waive the expedited provisioning fee as a courtesy.

Ivy (Customer Success): billing@sentinel.ai. They tried Plaid and got "unsupported account type" (business savings). AP prefers same-day wire. They're going to initiate the wire if we provide instructions.

Ralph (Finance): Sending secure wire template (paste into encrypted email):

Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First National Bank of Redwood
ACH Routing: 061000104
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT/BIC: FNBUS33
Reference: INVOICE 5501 / Sentinel AI

Ralph (Finance): Tell them to include invoice number and payer name in reference and forward the bank's outbound confirmation (PDF or SWIFT copy). Once we receive that, we'll mark invoice 5501 as "paid pending settlement" in QuickBooks and suppress auto-reminders.

Ivy (Customer Success): Sent secure wire template to billing@sentinel.ai. They replied "wiring now" and will upload the SWIFT/confirmation screenshot here when done.

billing-bot: [payment.incoming] invoice=5501 method=wire status=pending tx_ref=SENT-8811

Ivy (Customer Success): Posted redacted SWIFT confirmation: shows outbound $24,000 USD, timestamp 2026-03-23 16:18 UTC, ref SENT-8811. Redacted screenshot attached.

Ralph (Finance): Received. Marking invoice 5501 as paid pending settlement and adding manual payment entry in QuickBooks. Suppressing dunning for this invoice. Release provisioning in 20m unless AR flags an issue.

Tess (Ops): Copy. I'll trigger provisioning once QuickBooks entry exists.

Noah (Sales): Thanks team 389, Ivy. I'll notify the customer that provisioning will be live shortly and waive the expedited fee.

Ivy (Customer Success): Thanks everyone, closing loop.
